hypotheses.claim: Multiplicative load/depot/demand/route-distance gates on normalized removal savings, raised to a stagnation-dependent power p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio) in [1.0, 2.5] that grows with stagnation and decays with iter_frac, beats the incumbent r0006 scoring by >0.1% mean objective on dev_24 without increasing solve_ms_mean beyond ~110 ms, because high-stagnation phases need broad cluster-level diversification (top-q covering several spatially adjacent customers) while late iterations need sharp worst-removal exploitation.

next_search_advice.direction: Refine the `score_ruin_nodes` destruction priority toward a stagnation-adaptive multiplicative gating + rank-power rule that (a) widens spatial cluster removal when `stagnation_ratio` is high and instances are clustered, and (b) tightens toward pure worst-cost/removal-savings descent when `iter_frac` is late — targeting the weakest regimes reported by the archive (spatial=clustered, capacity_level=loose, depot_style=eccentric, size=100) where the current SBS (session_r0006, mean 16.0134) still leaves a 0.357% gap to VBS.
